tool.help:
# BayeScan
BayeScan is a program designed to identify candidate loci under natural selection from genetic data using differences in allele frequencies between populations.
## Input
BayeScan requires a specific input file format. Please refer to the [manual](http://cmpg.unibe.ch/software/BayeScan/files/BayeScan2.1_manual.pdf) for details on how to format your input file.
## Output
The tool produces a directory containing various output files, including: - Loci results - Parameter estimates - Summary statistics
## Advanced Options
You can optionally specify: - Burn-in period (default: 10000) - MCMC iterations (default: 100000) - Thinning interval (default: 10)
For more details, visit the [BayeScan website](http://cmpg.unibe.ch/software/BayeScan/).
